info.title: Showpass Organizer Tracking Links API
info.description: List, retrieve and manage tracking links with scoped organizer API keys.

get.description: Requires a developer key bound to the organization and an employee with Manage Venues or All Access. User-generated links are visible to the seller organization or the owner organization. Statistics may be cached for up to two minutes. Search by description, referrer username or slug. Use pagination for the matching links. Results can change between page requests.

post.description: Requires a developer key bound to the organization and an employee with Manage Venues or All Access. The server sets the seller from the key organization and derives the owner from the event when provided. Supply a destination URL or event for an ordinary link. For Quick Checkout Purchase, provide eligible basket items in extra. The create completes synchronously. Check for an existing link before retrying an ambiguous request.

put.description: Requires a developer key bound to the organization and an employee with Manage Venues or All Access. User-generated links are visible to the seller organization or the owner organization. The existing link must be a Quick Checkout Purchase link. Provide eligible basket items in extra when specifying that type. The server assigns the seller from the current organization. Confirm the saved link before retrying an ambiguous request.
